title: Neptune: The Long Orbit to Benchmarking Long Video Understanding

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent; footnote 4 gives the snapshot only)

task.subset_rule: all (NEPTUNE-FULL: 3,268 MCQs on 2,405 YouTube videos; restricted to videos still available)
task.approximation: Uniform 8-frame sampling and default image detail assumed; ASR from the release if present, otherwise Whisper; removed videos shrink the set (report coverage); choice formatting not printed.

items.source: github.com/google-deepmind/neptune -> https://storage.mtls.cloud.google.com/neptunedata/neptune_full.json (link redirects to a Google sign-in page without an authenticated Google account)

fields.label: answer_id
fields.video: video_id (YouTube URL; 8 frames and transcript must be extracted)

placeholders.video_frames: 8 uniformly spaced frames attached as image parts
placeholders.transcript: ASR transcript of the (truncated to 15 min) video
placeholders.question: items.question
placeholders.choices: answer + 4 decoys in release order (format not printed)

prompt.source_location: Appendix C.5.6 'GPT-4o prompts', 'Multiple-choice evaluation with transcript'
prompt.verbatim: full (as printed, including the doubled 'and and')

output.parse: text before the first ':' mapped to a choice (letter/number/text match with the choices)

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: share of MCQs whose parsed choice equals answer_id
metric.original_location: Table 4, row GPT-4o (RGB 8 frames + ASR), column NEPTUNE-FULL Acc.

open_points: Video input: 8 frames per video must be attached (text-only runner) after downloading the 2,405 YouTube videos (availability drift, ToS) and running ASR; the annotation JSON sits behind a Google sign-in wall (storage.mtls link).
Frame sampling rule, image resolution/detail and ASR engine are not stated; choice formatting (letters vs raw answer text) is not printed.

[card audit 2026-09-19] The anonymous release https://storage.googleapis.com/neptunedata/neptune_full.json holds 2,974 questions / 2,189 videos (paper 3,268 / 2,405); MMH 1,074 / 912 (paper 1,171 / 1,000). n_items 3268 is unattainable; video input remains the blocker.
notes: Cost driven by 8 images + transcript per call (~$0.03 each). NEPTUNE-MMH row (72.86) is the alternative cell. || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook: video/image input + gated annotations.
